Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 
TEST CHART FOR DIE SETS 



1. Scope — Prescribes limits of accuracies of die sets. 
1.1 This standard also covers die sets with ball guides. 

2. Preliminary Remarks 

2.1 The sequence of tests is related to the components of the die sets and does not define the 
practical order of testing. However, tests may be carried out in any convenient sequence. 

2.2 When inspecting a die set, it is necessary to carry out all the tests described in this standard 
except those tests which may be omitted in mutual agreement between the buyer and the 
manufacturer. 

2.3 The Indian standards published on die sets, guide bushes and guide posts are adjunct to 
this standard. 

3. Testing Instruments 

3.1 The testing instruments shall be of the approved type and shall be calibrated at a recognized 
temperature conforming to relevant Indian standards. 

3.2 Dial gauges shall be able to take a reading of 1 micron. Ail the gauges shall have an accuracy 
of 1 micron. 

4. Accuracy Requirements for Die Sets — The tests to be carried out, the instruments 
required and the maximum permissible error shall be as detailed in the test chart. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard has been prepared based upon the experience of our industry. Assistance has 
been derived from DIN 9811 ( Part 1 )-1980 'Press tool sets : Technical specification', issued by the 
Deutsches Institut fur Normung (DIN).
